snippet.title: Pac-Man/パックマン (Sharp Mz-2200, 1984, Dempa Shimbunsha/Namco/Toshio Tabeta)
snippet.description:
This is Pac-Man/パックマン for Sharp Mz-2200, I wasn't aware that this version was included the whole time as I been wanting to play it for a very long time. So, this version plays surprisingly well but still is similar to the Nec Pc-8001MkII, Sharp Mz-2500, Nec Pc-8801, and Nec Pc-8001MkIISR version. I like how this version uses a better beep than the two I played before. Getting a higher score than the rest was very rewarding to me and the coffee break scenes look beautiful. I recommend everyone to play this version as long as you have something to get it running or if you would like to see any other version of Pac-Man that was released.
